what: Kingston roots dub you play: the mixing desk is the instrument. Quantised mutes and throws into a tape echo and a spring you can kick, a stepped Big Knob filter on the mix or any channel, sirens, a band playing one drop, rockers and steppers, songs that keep your moves, and a runway that counts you to the one. Nothing plays itself. No Bluetooth MIDI; not yet tested on a device.
author: DocRuzzy (SpIllt Beats)
